challenge.method: Tested whether the three list placeholders require features to be present, whether the generic key is restricted to cases of unknown features, and whether it can represent an unknown or broader version grant.
challenge.results: A 1.3-only notice with zero Invariant Sections and a Back-Cover Text fits the generic edition choice. A 1.3-only notice with all three features absent also fits. Known feature details can be retained in the work notice in either case. If the notice is unavailable and there is no other evidence of authorization, the edition-only choice is unverified. An or-later notice grants a broader choice, so the generic edition-only key would understate that grant.

limitations: The generic identifier records the edition choice. It supplies no finding about Invariant Sections, Front-Cover Texts or Back-Cover Texts.

The filename GFDL-1.3-only.json and structured spdxId agree. The comment places only before the feature suffixes in its references to alternatives, including GFDL-1.3-only-no-invariants. The acquired feature-specific filename and spdxId place only last.
A real work's authorized notice determines its grant and feature designations. A metadata example cannot supply missing authorization.
